en-US.description: Spreadsheets and data: an open-source, high-performance modern spreadsheet application, built in pure Rust.
en-US.longDescription: GridCraft is an open-source, high-performance modern spreadsheet application, written from scratch in pure Rust. It is MIT OR Apache-2.0 licensed and runs natively on Windows, macOS and Linux.
en-US.name: GridCraft
en-US.releaseNotes:
## What's Changed
* Grant network access so update checks can reach GitHub by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/2841
* Honor CARGO_BUILD_TARGET in FreeBSD packaging for aarch64 release builds by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/2847
* Macro interface: Automate › Macros, Macros and Record Macro dialogs, step editor with a debugger by @prxnvt in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/478
* Macro engine: macro tokens, resolved to A1 references when a step runs by @prxnvt in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/2151
* Macro engine: the macro recorder and macro.list, get, save, delete, rename, record by @prxnvt in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/2152
* Macro engine: typed macros saved in the workbook by @prxnvt in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/465
* Macro engine: macro.run with input checks, a file-access policy and a check of each step by @prxnvt in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/2144
* Macro engine: macro.debug steps through a macro as one undo step by @prxnvt in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/2145
* Macro engine: macro.check and a footprint dry run, worked out before a macro runs by @prxnvt in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/2550
* Clear: Delete and the Clear commands skip the rows a filter hides (#1419) by @switch87 in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/1422
* packaging: Flatpak finds and prints to CUPS printers by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/2913
* CI: workflows only call craft-common-actions at @main (AGENTS.md; windows-arm64 unpinned) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/2921
* Update prompt shows the app icon and accent color instead of a letter by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/2928
* Fix pretend-version testing for update prompts by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/2934
* fix(engine): set default workbook author (#2448) by @AnhNgoo in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/2726
* fix(keyboard): Ctrl with the numpad's + inserts rows, columns or cells, as in Excel by @RomanLis91 in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/2769
* fix(grid): prevent partial wrapped text lines in fixed-height rows by @AnhNgoo in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/2817
* Open Excel's password-protected workbooks again: accept a hash-size integrity key (#2712) by @nct88 in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/2870
* Fix editing existing cell hyperlinks by @Plutonium-fream in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/2883
* Keep Fill Series value equal to stop despite float drift by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/2888
* Keep chart source outlines beneath floating objects by @Plutonium-fream in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/2896
* Formula pointing: Ctrl+arrow and Ctrl+Shift+arrow jump to the edge of the data (#2918) by @kkilchrist in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/2919
* Refusal to shift cells off the worksheet names GridCraft, not Excel (#2941) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/2955
* macOS menu test: use the whole native menu, so clippy passes on a Mac by @Aimarmndz in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/2970
* Click a status bar statistic to copy its value by @Dmussi in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/2620
* macOS: declare the UI languages so the open and save panels are translated by @Atalantis in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/2627
* CSV export: opt-in values: true writes raw cell values (#2648) by @Harrison-Booth in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/2666
* IMSQRT: reproduce Excel's stray real part for negative reals by @Harrison-Booth in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/2670
* Engine test: copying a sheet that holds a spill matches a full recalc (#2053) by @Harrison-Booth in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/2
